artBrief: **Cozy storybook.** A well-loved armchair, a slightly precarious book stack, and a tiny creature asleep on the armrest. Warm light gives the chair a recognizable silhouette.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Cozy storybook. A well-loved armchair, a slightly precarious book stack, and a tiny creature asleep on the armrest. Warm light gives the chair a recognizable silhouette. Use a tiny sleeping white fox on the chair armrest. Make the comfy amber armchair and chunky stack of blue/red books the main shapes; warm lamp light, gentle storybook interior.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
